issues: The subject was a grey placeholder dashboard; the three panels were crops of one screenshot and never read as one subject from three cameras
Pale grey paper and grey cards with no light or accent; no frame looked designed
During the hold the panels only crept in by a few percent, reading as a screenshot collage
The expansion landed on an enlarged '1,284' card with no end poster or copy
changes: Custom 'comic ink' look: red-tinted ink black, cream paper gutters, a single vermilion accent and halftone dots in each panel
Subject is a fictional SAROS 35mm f/1.2 lens drawn in SVG: 3/4 full body, focus-ring close-up and glass macro, all vector so text stays sharp at 2.45x
Cuts land every 4f: each slanted gutter draws top to bottom in 3f, its panel hard-cuts in with a white flash over the darkened original; comic caption boxes stamp in 7f later
Panels stay alive through the product itself: the focus ring turns 26 degrees past the red index and eleven aperture blades close
The last panel pulls back 2f then sweeps the screen in 14f with horizontal motion blur, landing on a poster with a 150px 'See in / the dark.' headline and a 50f hold
